issue_context.title: Improve logs for DNS failures
issue_context.body:
```
level=debug msg="Name To resolve: s3.amazonaws.com."
level=debug msg="[resolver] query s3.amazonaws.com. (A) from 172.20.0.2:55963, forwarding to udp:10.155.0.1"
level=debug msg="[resolver] failed to read from DNS server" error="dns: overflowing header size"
```

We should probably consider updating some of those logs to not be "debug" to make them more discoverable, and for that last one

- include the DNS server where the overflowing header size came from.
- include the query as well?

_Originally posted by @thaJeztah in https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/44575#issuecomment-1342395724_

review_comments: This'll do the wrong thing with IPv6 addresses. Use `net.JoinHostPort`

On second thought, I would rather leave this change for another PR dedicated to adding support for external IPv6 DNS servers. Every code path which sets the external servers filters out IPv6 addresses.
